package.description: Codebase intelligence and context engine for AI coding agents

en-US.description: Codebase intelligence and context engine for AI coding agents
en-US.longDescription: ctx indexes a codebase into a local SQLite code graph (files, symbols, dependencies) and produces relevance-ranked context packages for AI coding agents. Local-first, offline, private and deterministic. Includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over stdio.
en-US.name: ctx
